title: SWF: DefineButton2 and button symbol compilation
description: Compile Symbol items with symbolType=button to SWF DefineButton2 (tag 34) tags. A button has 4 frames: up, over, down, hit. Encode ButtonRecord array (characterId, layers, states flags). Wire up button state transitions in the compiled output. Tests: button with 2-state frames compiles to tag 34 with correct structure.
